title: Book Two · Chapter 105: The Front Table
story:
On Friday, Miss Wu puts their guide on the front table. Three other groups have small things to show. One group has book labels. Another has a list of lost coats.

Ronan waits with his hands behind his back. He knows the first line. The coat group speaks. Ronan says his own first line silently to himself.

Then Miss Wu nods to him.

“Our guide helps new pupils,” Ronan begins. “It shows the route from the main gate.”

He opens the cover. Mei's picture lies flat. A younger pupil at the front leans forward.

Ronan explains the long building and the broad steps. He names the two rooms. He holds the sample high enough for the back row.

“Clear voice,” someone says.

He smiles. Then he points to the back page.

“You can borrow books and picture sheets on Wednesday after lunch.”

Jun stands beside him. When a girl asks about the small gate, Jun answers.

“It is closed after lunch. Use the main gate.”

The girl nods. She writes something on her own little paper.

After the talk, Miss Wu gives them time at a side table. New pupils come to look. Some pupils follow the route with their fingers. One asks for a copy for his brother.

“We will have copies next week,” Ronan says.

“How many?” Jun asks quietly.

“Miss Wu said twenty.”

“That means twenty checks.”

Ronan looks at him. Jun is smiling a little. Ronan smiles back, but his mouth feels stiff.

The teacher in charge of the materials room does not come to the talk. Ronan sees an empty chair at the back. He tells himself she can read the copies later.

Miss Wu asks him to introduce the guide again. The larger reading meeting is next week. The groups will explain useful work to more pupils.

“You know your page,” she says.

Ronan says thank you. He wants to run to Leo and tell him.

Leo reaches him first. “You looked like a teacher.”

“A very short teacher,” Jun says.

“I am nearly as tall as you.”

“Nearly is a useful word.”

They laugh together. Ronan keeps the sample under his arm.

At home, Mum asks about his day. He tells her about the clear voice and the next meeting. Dad looks up from his cup.

“What is on your page?”

“A route. Book times. Things like that.”

“Can I see?”

Ronan puts the guide on the table. Dad follows the picture slowly. Mum reads the back.

“Wednesday,” she says. “Good to give a day.”

Ronan takes a long drink of water. Nobody asks how he checked Wednesday. His first notes still have the little question mark. The notebook is inside his bag.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

silently＝默默地；next week＝下一周；copy＝副本；stiff＝僵硬的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan因此得到哪次后续机会？
2. 他向父母讲了哪些内容？

## 读句子

**Dad / follows the picture / slowly.** Dad／慢慢地沿着／图画看。
